أذلولي (form XII)
# أَذْلَوْلِي (ʔaḏlawlī) /ʔað.law.liː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
# أَذْلَوْلِيَ (ʔaḏlawliya) /ʔað.law.li.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
